title: Two sacrificed artifacts changed the clock
story: My Atog attacked while my opponent sat at five life with no blocker. Before combat damage I sacrificed Frogmite to its ability, making Atog 3/4. I then sacrificed an Seat of the Synod , an artifact land I already controlled, and Atog became 5/6 until end of turn. Those two artifacts went to the graveyard as activation costs. When combat damage was dealt, the five power was lethal. I did not get an extra land play for sacrificing Seat of the Synod, and losing the artifact land would matter if the attack failed.
review: Atog 1/2 + 2*2/+2 = 5/6; sacrifices Frogmite + Seat of Synod are ability costs. 5 combat damage lethal to 5-life opponent; opponent no blocker.
